summary.tradeoffs: Bounce behavior is declared as a data flag (this.bounce) mirroring the ballistic primitive's p.bounce param; actual terrain reflection remains in stepBombTerrain()/collision handlers which read solidBehavior — full unification of that path lands with tasks 1.2/1.3. Special class untouched per task scope.
summary.decisions: Fields default to inert values so the existing straight-flight thorn path is byte-identical in behavior. Kept _ttlLabel on Projectile (Special already sets its own); tickTtl in Entity honors it for both classes. Did not touch Special.update() gravity line yet since Special still exists until 1.3 — Projectile now owns an equivalent integration so ballistic can route through either pool.
summary.done: Added gravityValue, bounce, explode, radius, _ttlLabel fields to Projectile.initialize() (defaults: 0/false/false/0/'life'). Moved gravity integration (vy += gravityValue*dt gated by _bombSettled) from Special.update() into Projectile.update(). Existing thorn callers unaffected (gravityValue defaults 0). node --check passes; projectile.test.js (31), specialRotation.test.js (20), bomb.test.js (13), bombGameplay.test.js all pass.
summary.lessons_learned: Previous attempt likely burned budget exploring before editing; the plan snippet was empty and the 'bounce' acceptance criterion maps to the ballistic primitive's solidBehavior='reflect' mapping, not a new physics method — reading ballistic.js once resolved the ambiguity. Pool.spawn() deletes ALL entity keys before re-initialize, so new fields must be set in initialize(), never only at spawn time.
